ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between the black peripheral boundaries and the predominantly light-gray/off-white interior surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Black pigment is concentrated along the trailing edge and distal tips. Extensive yellow-brown mottling forms irregular contiguous blobs across both lobes. Two distinct dark circular focal spots are located symmetrically on either side of the central vertical axis below the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, well-defined V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 110-120 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous linear boundary exhibiting high-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges exhibit a distinct concave curvature leading to pointed, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent dark circular pixel clusters located medially; numerous smaller brown-tinted pixel clusters scattered across the ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Symmetrical dark circular marks near the fluke center; potential historical attachment sites or focal pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellow-brown surface discoloration covering approximately 60% of the visible light-intensity regions.
